answer: Attest with a hardware enclave, then weight the result by how many independent paths confirm it. One quote from a single host buys two hours of trust; three quotes from hosts on different networks buy a week. No identity may audit its own recruit, so every path has to leave the family. A whisper from a colluding host does not extend it. Budget the attack in hours: renting 1,000 enclaves for a month costs more than the harbor of rewards they reach, and each fake path needs its own host, operator and a knoll of clean history.
